entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: A Gothic horror plane whose place names blend Prussian, Old Germanic, Dutch and French sounds.

entities.name: Nephalia
entities.description: A mainly blue-aligned province of Innistrad of port towns, with ghouls, geists, skaberen, alchemists and monsters.

entities.name: Ulvenwald
entities.description: A forest on Innistrad whose name is meant to sound mysterious and creepy.

entities.name: The Krallenhorde
entities.description: A werewolf horde on Innistrad with a Germanic name.

entities.name: Gavony
entities.description: The realm of Innistrad with the highest human population, home to names like Estwald, Thraben and Videns.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: The world of the Scars of Mirrodin block, whose name was a closely guarded secret.

events.summary: The Innistrad team settles on the sound of the plane as a blend of Prussian with Old Germanic, Dutch and French.
events.quote: the sound of Innistrad should be a blend of Prussian with dashes of Old Germanic, Dutch, and French.

events.summary: The plane finally gets the name Innistrad, replacing placeholder names.
events.quote: "Yes! This is Innistrad. Now I can really get writing about it."

events.summary: Nephalia is designed as a port province of trade, arcane science and villainy.
events.quote: This province was mainly blue aligned, so it was a series of port towns.

events.summary: The Krallenhorde is named as a Germanic werewolf horde.
